findings.title: Role names a resource that does not exist
findings.cause: container watcher exits because the API server refuses its ServiceAccount app: it may not list configmaps in namespace kd-rbac-resource-singular. Role settings-reader grants get, list, watch on resource "configmap", and the API has no resource by that name: it is "configmaps" (resource names are lower case and plural), so the rule never matches; its log says: "Error from server (Forbidden): configmaps is forbidden: User \"system:serviceaccount:kd-rbac-resource-singular:app\" cannot list resource \"configmaps\" in API group \"\" in the namespace \"kd-rbac-resource-…"; Deployment config-watcher has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container watcher exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 6 times
last lines of container watcher's log (run that exited)
evidence.detail: Error from server (Forbidden): configmaps is forbidden: User "system:serviceaccount:kd-rbac-resource-singular:app" cannot list resource "configmaps" in API group "" in the namespace "kd-rbac-resource-singular"

evidence.what: Role settings-reader, bound by RoleBinding app-settings-reader: apiGroups [""], resources ["configmap"], verbs ["get", "list", "watch"]
evidence.command: kubectl get role settings-reader -n kd-rbac-resource-singular -o jsonpath='{.rules}'

evidence.what: RoleBinding app-settings-reader grants Role settings-reader to ServiceAccount app

findings.fix: Write "configmaps" for "configmap" in the resources of Role settings-reader (kubectl api-resources lists the names).
